title: The rent fell. The filings didn't.
subtitle: Travis County renters, from the apartment boom to eviction court
alt: Timeline of Austin rents and Travis County eviction filings: the Austin Apartment Association counts about 86,000 rental units added since 2023; Senate Bill 38 took effect Jan. 1, 2026, limiting local courts from requiring mediation or a pretrial conference before an eviction trial; in June 2026 the median asking rent was $1,371, down 4.3 percent from a year earlier, and Travis County saw roughly 1,500 eviction filings, about 60 percent above the baseline; and over the most recent 12 months there were more than 15,600 filings, 35 percent above the 2023-24 average, or about one case for every 20 renter households
source: Eviction Lab and Realtor.com figures, via CBS Austin
